The internet told us that.On @newsnationnow with @alcaprari23 I reflected on the passing of Chuck Norris, a man whose accomplishments almost feel mythical.86 years old.An 8th-degree black belt in Taekwondo the first Westerner ever to achieve it.A six-time undefeated middleweight karate champion.Those numbers alone tell you enough.Most people remember the memes:“Chuck Norris doesn’t do pushups… he pushes the Earth down.”But behind the jokes was a man of discipline, conviction, and relentless fitness.
